idea-plugin.name: Koda Dark
idea-plugin.description:
Koda Dark Theme for JetBrains IDEs

A sleek, minimalist dark theme for JetBrains IDEs based on Neovim's popular Koda theme.

Features

  • Palette: Deep #181818 background with crisp #cccccc text and #b0b0b0 foreground.
  • Syntax Highlighting: Subtle #777777 keywords and types, with golden #d9ba73 functions and constants.
  • IDE Appearance: Unified UI theme supporting both JetBrains New UI and Classic UI.
  • Terminal: Built-in terminal color palette matching Koda dark specifications.
